links.outcome: Clinician trust (5-point Likert) in LLM oncology recommendations with vs without source citations and claim-level source linking
links.effect: Trust was 2.59 for recommendation only vs 3.01 with source citation; atomic fact-checking linked to guideline sources reached 3.80 (d=0.94 vs pooled controls). Trust measured, not error detection.
links.quote: Mean trust scores were 2.59 (95% CI, 2.54–2.64) for recommendation only, 2.84 (2.79–2.90) for explanation, 3.01 (2.97–3.05) for source citation, 3.09 (3.04–3.14) for combined explanation and citation, and 3.80 (3.76–3.84) for AFC.
